name: MKX 1 Gram 510 Thread Carts *LIMITED EDITION* - Vanilla Chaicake (Hybrid)
description:
Vanilla Chaicake (H) – 2025 Winter Collection
Indulge in creamy decadence with Vanilla Chaicake, a hybrid that balances relaxation and focus. One of the 5 limited strains in the 2025 Winter Collection, this dessert-inspired vape combines vanilla, doughy sweetness, and chai spice for a cozy, indulgent experience.

The #1 selling vape cartridge on the market, MKX Carts deliver an activated, award-winning THC oil with the highest THC level possible and sensational flavor. Our strain library is constantly adapting to introduce exciting new terpenes and flavors.
